qualifierLines: {**13 NY3d at 786} OPINION OF THE COURT

Today's decision correctly applies People v Hines (97 NY2d 56, 61-62 [2001]). I have expressed my unhappiness with Hines before (, 3 NY3d 266, 273 [2004, R.S. Smith, J., concurring]), but this case, in which the Appellate Division did not mention preservation, defendant does not argue the issue, and the Appellate Division's decision on the merits seems clearly correct, is not the right one for further examination of the Hines rule.
